name: Alpine Coaster Imst
kurzbeschreibung: The Alpine Coaster in Hoch-Imst: At 3,525 metres in length, it is the longest alpine roller coaster in the world, packed with curves, waves, and hairpin bends.
beschreibung:
Overview

The spectacular Alpine Coaster Imst is located in the sunny alpine amphitheatre of Hoch-Imst above the district capital of Imst in the Tyrolean Oberland, starting at an altitude of 1,550 metres above sea level. Boasting an astonishing track length of 3,525 metres, the ride holds the official world record as the longest alpine roller coaster on Earth. Descending a vertical drop of roughly 500 metres, this track-guided mountain coaster winds its way through dense mountain forests and scenic alpine pastures down into the valley, delivering pure excitement for thrill-seekers of all ages.

Thrills & Engineering Highlights

Visitors ascend to the start aboard the modern 10-seater gondola UngaBungabahn (Section I of the Imster Bergbahnen) from Hoch-Imst up to the Untermarkter Alm mid-station. Once strapped into the ergonomic two-seater sled, guests embark on an exhilarating descent lasting roughly nine minutes. The elevated rail system tackles diverse terrain features: along with sweeping banked turns, tight switchbacks, and sudden terrain drops, a dizzying 450-degree loop structure elevated high above the ground guarantees thrills. In certain sections, riders glide up to six metres above the forest floor. Two side-mounted hand brakes allow passengers to regulate their own speed, capped safely at 40 km/h by magnetic centrifugal governors and safety belts. At the valley terminal, an expansive adventure playground, family swimming lake, and rustic mountain taverns invite guests to relax.

Visit & Getting There

Alpine Coaster Imst operates during the summer season from early May until late October, as well as on designated winter holiday dates (weather permitting during heavy rain or snowfall). Operating hours during peak summer: daily from 09:00 to 17:00. Ticket prices for gondola ascent plus one coaster descent (2025/2026 season): adults approx. €16.50, youth (ages 16 to 18) approx. €14.00, children (from age 3 accompanied, or solo from age 8) approx. €11.50. Multi-ride packages and family bundles are available. Arriving by car: via the Inntalautobahn A12 (exit Imst/Pitztal), driving through Imst town following directional signs to Hoch-Imst / Bergbahnen (large free car park at the valley station). By public transport: take the ÖBB train to Imst-Pitztal station, then catch the regular local bus service directly to the Hoch-Imst chairlift base.

Tips

Children aged 3 and above may ride accompanied by an adult, while children from age 8 with a minimum height of 1.25 m can pilot their own sled. During peak summer holiday periods, morning arrivals are recommended to avoid ticket queues. Pair your coaster descent with a scenic hike through the dramatic Rosengartenschlucht Gorge, which leads on foot from Imst town centre right up to Hoch-Imst.
